corrections.reason: Stage 1 introduced Latin characters ('አhad') for the Ethiopic numeral and accusative ending '፩ደ', and misread the 5th-order accusative 'ብእሴ' as 'ብእሲ'.
The initial character of 'አራተኛ' (fourth) is 1st-order 'አ', misread as 6th-order 'እ' due to slight ink wear.
The Ge'ez term 'ማየ ምንዝሕ' (water of sprinkling/purification) ends in 6th-order 'ሕ', which is clearly visible on the page image.
The printed Ge'ez verb is 'ይቅጽብዎሙ' (from ቀጸበ, to signal/tip off, rendered in the Amharic commentary on L36-37 as 'ጠቁሶ'); 'ጽ' was misread as 'ድ'.
